name: metatron
description: Metatron, the operating system for digital assets, inside Claude: launch and grow a token, tokenize a real asset, build a real index token over tokenized stocks, gold and crypto with live prices or over a basket of private assets, put a company's or a wallet's crypto to work, take payments, buy crypto and learn, each step as a live card. Routes every request to the right rail through the Metatron connector.
